label: Shopify product CSV (compliance metafields)

source.title: Shopify Help Center — Using CSV files to import and export products

columns.note: Shopify keys rows by Handle, not SKU. If the seller's handles differ from their SKUs this column must be remapped before import.

notes: Column header format `Name (product.metafields.<namespace>.<key>)` is from Shopify's own documentation, read 13 Sept 2026.
Each metafield must be DEFINED first under Settings > Custom data > Products, or the column is ignored on import.
Variant metafields are not supported by product CSV import/export; these are product-level only.
verified stays false until someone has run this file through a real Shopify import and seen the values land.
